verdict.rationale: Instinct is documented as an autonomous personal assistant that proactively follows up on dropped threads and calls or texts the user. Hands-on reviewers saw it run delegated work in the background, such as podcast booking follow-ups where it pinged the reviewer only when needed, and it booked an overdue medical appointment unprompted. However, nothing documents user-configured automations: no recurring schedules, triggers or rules. Background work shows up only as proactive or delegated agent behavior, and the evidence is thin (one-off actions rather than recurring schedules). Missing for 10: explicit user-defined automation setup, recurring schedule or trigger support, first-party documentation of background task management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
